name: Hong Kong Championship 2025

venue.name: [The Wave](https://thewave.com.hk/)
venue.address: 4 Hing Yip Street, Kwun Tong, Kowloon

information: 所有項目的決賽將會預留最多8個名額或50%的名額(以較少者為準)給代表香港的參賽者。 而相關有預留名額的輪次，預留名額將優先按上一輪次代表香港的參賽者的成績排名安排晉級，之後再按上一輪次所有參賽者的成績排名安排晉級餘下的名額。 For final round of all events, a maximum of 8 spaces or 50% of spaces (Lower one) will be reserved for competitors representing Hong Kong. For a round with reserved spaces, the competitors advancing from the previous round are a reserved number of best competitors representing Hong Kong, followed by the remaining best competitors representing any region.
